title: 第23章 才开始第24章 阵法之威
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
明宣无奈，寒风作响，此刻场中大战依旧在持续。
“铛铛铛”的声音袭来，巨大葫芦挡住刀锋，殷老五全力压制独臂狂刀，后者握紧阔刀后退。
一拳带着罡风袭来，阔刀抵挡，但是那重力似巨山压顶，独臂刀客不好受，一个踉跄翻滚卷起无数积雪...
明王拳没有停止，徐老埋头苦干，丝毫不给搬山道人出手机会，搬山道人无奈，这个看似文绉绉的老头发起狠居然是这么利落干脆。
“山河隐！”
搬山道人无奈，终于祭出灵术，当下整个人消失，山河印自动旋转幻化无数山印，他的身影也是消失。
当一片雪花破碎，四面八方密密麻麻的山河印袭来，徐老抱守心神，眉心发光。
“明王八臂拳！”
背后发光，左右各自长出三条手臂，阻挡着如蜂群涌来的山河印。
此刻场内人形方阵动了，八个活死人出手了，一股死气弥漫，黎红月一惊，黑色箭雨袭来之时，那妖道拂尘扫来之际，一片片红色枫叶落下。
“秋风扫叶！”
如秋的悲凉，如血般醒目，片片枫叶斩断箭雨，长剑一转也是击退拂尘。
“不好了，局势要逆转了。”
平台上慕容仙儿低语，一旁左丘辰早已经呆若木鸡，他何曾见过这样的场面？
广场被红胡子老头所化的巨人踩碎，黑气笼罩了大半个广场，刀光和剑气斩得四周一片疮痍。
而沐战和明宣依旧对峙，沐战死死的拦住明宣，作为实力最强的明宣根本无法援救。
随着四方人阵和活死人的加入，本来还占据上风的北宣学院几人渐渐有了溃败之势。
地面再次裂开，无数骷髅冒起，巨大的镰刀划破巨人脚底，变成红胡子巨人的明远发出一声惨叫，随后身形慢慢缩小。
另一边，许长老双拳袭在冥府二人胸前，但是自己也是被两拳击打在胸口，三道身影再次弹射开。
不得不说许长老很强，以一敌二，从兵器到赤手空拳他都能压制住两人，而他的对手也很强大，此刻场中只有他们三人受伤最严重。

“独臂，有什么就使出来吧，分个胜负！”
酒人殷老五站在雪中严肃道，对面独臂狂刀嘴角带着鲜血，但是眼中的战意和刀锋更甚。
“可以！”
简单两字吐出，然后独臂刀客刀锋向上，全身灵力汇聚刀身，无数雪花凝住变成飞刀，阔刀朝天，刀锋足足有五十余米，所有雪花凝成飞刀，渐渐一面斩天冰刀呈现。
“霸刀决，悍刀斩！”
此刻所有人抬头皆是被这股骇人的威势镇住了，那一面墙的冰刀和狂刀斩下。
徐老和搬山道人惊愕，妖道和黎红月抬头凝视，人形方阵和骷髅之众也被这冷冷的杀意镇住。
“他做个五长老有点屈才。”此刻沐战开口言道。所言并不是指独臂狂刀的攻势，反而指凝神闭目的殷老五。
在众人惊愕的神情中，在刀锋来临之际，殷老五笑了，而且笑得很苍白。
“此情恨也罢，爱也罢，只是无诀期！”
“放手吧，逝者难追！”
说着，手中的紫金葫芦翻滚而上立在空中，一股比阴气还冷的无情气息流出。
片片雪花中，殷老五睁眼，画面突变，葫芦破碎，雕栏玉砌前一位女子抚琴。
琴声声声响彻心扉，弹起了那来自心底的悲伤，女子微笑，可又似雾似梦般不真实，神乎其神的手段让众人叹为观止。
content_en:
Ming Xuan was helpless, the cold wind was blowing, and the battle in the field was still going on at this moment.
The sound of "clang, clang, clang" came, and the huge gourd blocked the blade. Yin Laowu used all his strength to suppress the one-armed mad sword, and the latter clenched the broad sword and retreated.
A punch came with a strong wind, and the broad sword resisted it, but the gravity was like a huge mountain pressing on the top of the mountain. The one-armed swordsman felt uncomfortable, and he staggered and rolled up countless snow...
Mingwang Fist did not stop, Mr. Xu worked hard and did not give Taoist Banshan a chance to attack. Taoist Banshan was helpless, this seemingly docile old man was so clean and crisp in his attack.
"Shanheyin!"
The mountain-moving Taoist was helpless and finally used his spiritual skills. Immediately, his whole person disappeared. The mountain and river seals automatically rotated and transformed into countless mountain seals, and his figure also disappeared.
When a snowflake shattered and dense mountain and river prints came from all directions, Mr. Xu held on to his mind and his eyebrows glowed.
"Mingwang Eight-Armed Fist!"
The back glows, and three arms grow out on the left and right, blocking the mountains and rivers that are coming like a swarm of bees.
At this moment, the humanoid square in the field moved, and the eight living dead took action. A sense of death filled the air. Li Hongyue was startled. When the black arrow rain hit, when the demon whisk swept over, pieces of red maple leaves fell.
"The autumn wind sweeps the leaves!"
As desolate as autumn, as eye-catching as blood, the maple leaves cut off the rain of arrows, and the long sword also repels the fly whisk.
"Oops, the situation is about to reverse."
Murong Xian'er whispered on the platform. Zuo Qiuchen was already dumbfounded. How had he ever seen such a scene?
The square was trampled to pieces by the giant transformed by the red-bearded old man. Black energy enveloped most of the square, and the light of the sword and sword energy caused devastation all around.
Mu Zhan and Ming Xuan were still at odds, with Mu Zhan firmly blocking Ming Xuan. As the strongest Ming Xuan, there was no way he could save him.
With the addition of the Quartet and the living dead, the few people from Beixuan College who had the upper hand gradually began to be defeated.
The ground cracked open again, countless skeletons emerged, and the huge scythe scratched the soles of the giant's feet. Mingyuan, who turned into a red-bearded giant, let out a scream, and then slowly shrank in size.
On the other side, Elder Xu punched the two people in Hades on their chests, but he was also hit in the chest by two punches, and the three figures bounced away again.
It has to be said that Elder Xu is very strong. When one versus two, he can suppress two people with weapons or bare hands, and his opponent is also very powerful. At this moment, only the three of them are the most seriously injured.
"One-armed, use whatever you have to decide the winner!"
The bartender Yin Laowu said solemnly while standing in the snow. Opposite him was the one-armed mad sword with blood on the corner of his mouth, but the fighting spirit and blade in his eyes were even greater.
"Okay!"
After spitting out two simple words, the one-armed swordsman pointed his blade upward, and all his spiritual energy gathered on the blade. Countless snowflakes condensed and turned into flying knives. The broad sword pointed upwards, and the blade was more than fifty meters long. All the snowflakes condensed into flying knives, and gradually a sky-cutting ice knife appeared.
"Hegemonic Sword Judgment, Fierce Sword Slash!"
At this moment, everyone raised their heads and was stunned by this terrifying power. The ice blades and crazy knives slashed down the wall.
Mr. Xu and Taoist Banshan were shocked. Yao Dao and Li Hongyue raised their heads and stared. The human phalanx and skeletons were also restrained by this cold murderous intention.
"It's a bit unworthy of him to be a fifth elder." Mu Zhan said at this moment. What he said was not referring to the offensive attack of the one-armed mad sword, but to Yin Laowu who was concentrating and closing his eyes.
Amid everyone's shocked expressions, Yin Laowu smiled, and his smile was very pale when the blade came.
"Whether it's hate or love, there's just no time to say goodbye!"
"Let go, the dead are hard to catch up with!"
As he spoke, the purple gold gourd in his hand rolled up and stood in the air, and a ruthless aura that was colder than Yin Qi flowed out.
In the snowflakes, Yin Laowu opened his eyes, the scene suddenly changed, the gourd was broken, and a woman played the piano in front of the jade railing.
The sound of the piano resounded through the heart, playing the sadness from the bottom of the heart. The woman smiled, but it was as unreal as fog or a dream. Her miraculous method amazed everyone.
